apps.localizedDescription:
KeyPhone:

A Series 40–style keypad phone that runs on your Mac and iPhone. The phone's keypad, menus and screen are one HTML file; the Mac and iPhone apps wrap it and connect it to the system, so calls, messages, contacts, photos and alarms are real.

Website: https://harkhowalia-1.github.io/KeyPhone/ Play in your browser: https://harkhowalia-1.github.io/KeyPhone/play/

Features:

• Calls and VoIP: dial through the iPhone, or make real calls over your own SIP/VoIP account (WebRTC), with hold, mute, keypad tones and a call log.
• Messages and contacts: multi-tap, predictive text, the Messenger's keyboard or the iPhone keyboard; Names is your device's address book.
• Camera, Gallery and Recorder: a live viewfinder, photos saved exactly as framed, your Photos library, voice memos.

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: KeyPhone's music player plays the songs in your music library.

privacy.NSContactsUsageDescription: KeyPhone shows and edits your iPhone contacts in the phone's Names list.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: KeyPhone shows the weather where you are.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KeyPhone uses the microphone for VoIP calls, the Recorder and video.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Photos and videos taken with KeyPhone's camera are saved to your library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: KeyPhone's Gallery shows your photos and videos, and its camera saves pictures to your library.
